commands.name: design
commands.description: Design document: '/design project' for the whole-project design and guidelines, '/design <feature>' for a feature design; waits for approval
commands.prompt:
Use the `design-doc` skill.

If the request below is empty or is "project", use project mode: analyse the whole codebase and create or update the project design document at docs/design/project-design.md, including the architecture, tech stack, core domain model, cross-cutting conventions, complexity budgets and numbered guidelines (G1, G2, ...).

Otherwise use feature mode: first read docs/design/project-design.md if it exists and treat its approved guidelines as binding, then write the feature design document under docs/design/. Catalogue every data structure (fields, types, where defined, invariants, persistence), the interfaces, algorithms with time and space complexity, data flow, error handling, testing, rollout, and a project design conformance table.

Present a summary and stop for approval. Do not implement anything until the design is approved.

Request: $ARGUMENTS

rule: The approved project design document (docs/design/project-design.md) is the project's guidelines. Before designing, planning or implementing any feature, read it and follow its numbered guidelines (G1, G2, ...). If a request conflicts with an approved guideline, stop and say so; never deviate without an explicitly approved amendment to the project design. Use the `design-doc` skill for feature designs, and `/design project` to create or update the project design.
